tools.name: route_country_apostille_and_legalization_authority
tools.description: Match applicant issuing country and certificate category against 16 national authentication profiles to identify federal vs provincial Apostille agencies, statutory fees, and SAFEA compliance notes.

tools.name: calculate_180day_document_validity_radar
tools.description: Measure elapsed calendar days since police check issuance, deduct DHL courier and SAFEA bureau review buffers, and classify net safe filing windows into safe, warning, critical, or expired.

tools.name: check_us_federal_vs_state_apostille_jurisdiction
tools.description: Prevent automatic Chinese work permit rejection by matching U.S. FBI checks, university diplomas, TEFL certificates, or state police clearances to USDOS or 10 state Secretaries of State with RON rules.

tools.name: inspect_country_deep_legalization_dossier
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive stage-by-stage authentication timelines, fingerprint requirements, Tier-1 municipal enforcement nuances, and printable filing checklists from deep jurisdiction dossiers.

tools.name: audit_safea_translation_and_remote_notary_compliance
tools.description: Verify whether a translation package satisfies PRC mainland corporate dual-seal mandates and evaluate Shanghai, Beijing, GBA, and Tier-2 city acceptance of Remote Online Notarization (RON).

tools.name: diagnose_zvisa_document_rejection_risks
tools.description: Screen an applicant filing configuration against documented high-frequency SAFEA RFE triggers including mismatched state/federal apostilles, expired 6-month police checks, and sealed envelope breaches.

tools.name: retrieve_multilingual_police_clearance_guide
tools.description: Fetch complete native-language SAFEA criminal record and Apostille instructions, timelines, RFE case studies, and FAQs in Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, or Spanish.

tools.name: generate_printable_visa_dossier_checklist
tools.description: Assemble an ordered end-to-end document authentication checklist tailored by home country and visa role (Standard Z-Visa, ESL Teacher, S1/S2 Dependent, or Corporate POA).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_us_federal_vs_state_apostille_jurisdiction" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
